opener: Lord, I am the one everyone calls when their world is falling apart, and somewhere in all that calling, nobody ever thought to ask who's holding me up.
paragraphs: I didn't sign up to be the strong one forever — I just kept showing up, and showing up quietly became a job description nobody wrote down but everyone expects me to keep. I've answered calls at midnight I didn't have the strength for. I've said "I'm fine" so many times it stopped feeling like a lie and started feeling like a role I can't take off. But You never told the weary to keep performing strength until they collapsed. You said come, and trade — hand over the yoke I built for myself for the one You actually designed to fit.

So tonight I am setting down what was never mine to carry alone — the family that leans on me, the friends who only call when it's bad, the version of myself that has to be okay so everyone else can be. Teach me the difference between helping and disappearing into everybody else's need. Give me a rest that reaches all the way down to my soul, not just a nap between other people's crises. Let someone finally carry something for me too. In Jesus' name, amen.

kicker: A Prayer For The One Everyone Calls Strong
footerNote: Save this for the strong one who never gets to be tired
